summary: Iteration 150: Tested AddCandidateToMandateDialog enhancement with Sourced/Search Bank tabs. All UI features working correctly. Backend mandate_id filter verified. Search Bank tab has slow API response (~13s) due to large candidate bank (107K+ records).

minor.issue: Search API takes ~13 seconds to respond with 107K+ candidates in database
minor.note: Not a bug - performance optimization opportunity

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ AddCandidateToMandateDialog opens from 'Add Candidate' button on job cards
✅ Sourced tab is active by default (has bg-white class)
✅ Sourced tab auto-fetches candidates with mandate_id filter from /api/candidate-bank
✅ Empty state shows 'No sourced candidates yet' with helpful description
✅ Search Bank tab has search input with data-testid='candidate-search-input'
✅ Search requires minimum 2 characters (shows 'Type at least 2 characters' message)
✅ Tab switching works correctly between Sourced and Search Bank
✅ Backend /api/candidate-bank?mandate_id=<id> returns correct filtered results (0 for jobs with no sourced candidates)
⚠️ Search API is slow (~13s) due to large candidate bank - not a bug, performance optimization opportunity
context_for_next_testing_agent: AddCandidateToMandateDialog enhancement tested and verified. Dialog opens from job cards on /admin/jobs, /employer/jobs, /recruiter/jobs. Has two tabs: Sourced (auto-loads candidates with mandate_id filter) and Search Bank (manual search). All features working. Note: Search API is slow (~13s) with 107K+ candidates - this is a performance issue, not a bug.
